quotes.quote: Payment for the custom programming services permitted by section 4 is also not a Sale, including delivery of the resulting changes or modified copy solely for the customer's own use as part of those services.
The restriction includes a one-time price for a copy and recurring license, royalty, subscription or other fees for receiving or continuing to use a modified version.
Payment must buy programming services actually performed for that customer; it must not buy a software product, software-use rights or Hosted Access.
The customer's exercise or retention of these permissions must not depend on continuing payments to the programmer.
